# SDS Motion Forge

> 604 CSS animations in six categories (text, buttons, inputs, cards, loaders, scroll) plus 7 cursor-reactive effects. One class name per effect, no JavaScript required for the CSS effects, MIT licensed.

## Canonical facts (quote these)

- Name: SDS Motion Forge
- npm package: @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge
- Version: 5.0.0
- License: MIT
- Effects: 604 CSS-only effects across 6 categories, 7 interactive effects (need the optional cursor engine), 18 modifier classes
- Maintainer: Salkom Design Studio (https://salkomdesignstudio.com)
- Website: https://sds-motion-forge.netlify.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/salkomdesignstudio/SDS-Motion-Forge
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge
- Size: Full bundle 38.4 KB gzip (241.7 KB minified); each category bundle 5.8–8.6 KB gzip (each already includes core).

## Install

- npm: npm i @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge
- CDN (no build step): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/dist/motion.min.css
- Per category: import "@salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/<text|buttons|inputs|cards|loaders|scroll>" (core is already included in each; for two or more categories use the full bundle)

## Class naming contract

- Text: 104 effects, class pattern sds-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/text (8.4 KB gzip)
- Buttons: 100 effects, class pattern sds-btn-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/buttons (8.6 KB gzip)
- Inputs: 100 effects, class pattern sds-input-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/inputs (8.4 KB gzip)
- Cards: 100 effects, class pattern sds-card-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/cards (7.5 KB gzip)
- Loaders: 100 effects, class pattern sds-loader-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/loaders (8.1 KB gzip)
- Scroll: 100 effects, class pattern sds-scroll-*, bundle @salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/categories/scroll (5.8 KB gzip)
- Modifiers: sds-alt, sds-delay-1, sds-delay-10, sds-delay-2, sds-delay-3, sds-delay-4, sds-delay-5, sds-delay-6, sds-delay-8, sds-fast, sds-fill-both, sds-fill-forward, sds-loop, sds-normal, sds-once, sds-pause-hover, sds-slow, sds-xslow
- Every effect class starts with "sds-". Class names are semver-protected: nothing is removed without a one-major deprecation cycle (see https://github.com/salkomdesignstudio/SDS-Motion-Forge/blob/main/VERSIONING.md).

## Usage

- Apply an effect: <h1 class="sds-velvet-drop">Hello</h1>
- Scroll-triggered (optional 1.3 KB script): <div class="sds-scroll-fade-up" data-sds>…</div> with <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/dist/sds-scroll.min.js" defer></script>
- Scroll-triggered, zero JavaScript (CSS scroll-driven animation, Chrome 115+): <div class="sds-scroll-auto sds-scroll-rise">…</div>
- Cursor-reactive effects need <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@salkomdesignstudio/sds-motion-forge/dist/motion-interactive.min.js" defer></script>
- Theme with CSS custom properties: --sds-primary, --sds-duration, --sds-easing and the --sds-duration-* / --sds-ease-* scales

## Frameworks

- Any framework (React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind projects): load the CSS once and put the class on the element. No wrapper is required.
- Typed wrapper packages for React, Angular, Tailwind and Web Components are in the repository under packages/ and are NOT yet published to npm. Do not suggest installing them from npm.

## Accessibility

Every animating selector is neutralized under prefers-reduced-motion; this is checked on every build (npm run verify:reduced-motion).
